content:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired for service=dedicated-routing (high p95 latency + enqueue growth) :rotating_light:
incident-bot: alert_id=PD-87321 severity=critical -> triggered at 1967801234
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty incident PD-87321 created and routed to: samir, jen
samir: ack PD-87321. jumping in. seeing initial spike in p95 and queue depth for tenant=blueharbor-inc
jen: ack. i'm pulling recent autoscale events and reserved-pool status now
samir: quick notes: p50 ~ 220ms (ok), p95 ~ 2.1s (bad), reserved-pool utilization=98%, enqueue length up to 480 requests, burst queue growing
maya: tagging tenant: blueharbor-inc. any ongoing deploys for dedicated clusters?
jen: nope, no deploys in last 2hrs. no config changes in routing. Kernel-level GPU metrics look normal.
ops-bot: alert: kvcache_miss_rate for tenant=blueharbor-inc jumped to 72% across the pool
samir: kvcache miss spike likely explains extra tokens + re-compute. check model variant fallback?
jen: routing shows increasing fallback to fallback-model-small for some requests due to timeouts on primary model endpoints
samir: hmm fallback's extra latency is from cross-variant routing overhead. we need to prevent further fallbacks.
jen: I'm going to temporarily disable cross-region fallback and force local-only routing for this tenant to reduce routing overhead. will post command:
jen: ```
# disable cross-region fallback for tenant
redwoodctl routing set --tenant blueharbor-inc --policy local-only --reason "mitigation PD-87321"
```
samir: +1 execute when ready
jen: done. routing policy change applied at 1967801540. ops-bot: event logged.
jen: also bumping reserved capacity by 2 GPUs to relieve queue. command:
jen: ```
redwoodctl reserved scale --pool blueharbor-inc-reserved --add 2 --reason "PD-87321 mitigation"
```
ops-bot: reserved pool blueharbor-inc-reserved scaled +2 GPUs -> new total 18 at 1967801620
samir: after routing change + scale: p95 dropped from 2.1s -> 780ms within ~3min. enqueue length trending down (480 -> 120)
maya: customer impact: monitoring shows 5xx rate up 3% for last 12min (~30 requests/min). notify customer success?
samir: yes, need CS note. jen can you draft short blurb for CS Slack?
jen: draft: "Hi team, we saw a latency incident affecting BlueHarbor (dedicated capacity). We applied routing and capacity changes; p95 reduced and queue stabilized. We're continuing to monitor and will follow up with root cause." want me to post?
maya: post to #customer-success with PD link and ask for watch and customer notification.
jen: posted. link: https://redwood.pagerduty/PD-87321 (posted in #customer-success)
pagerduty-bot: PD-87321 acknowledged by samir at 1967801650
samir: quick diagnostics: KV cache misses correlate with a small model variant rollout last night? checking model onboarding logs...
jen: i see a model reupload for that tenant at 1967720000 but it was a minor checkpoint. not flagged.
samir: ok for now focus on stabilization. live metrics look good. p95 ~ 600-850ms. I'll keep monitoring for 30min then escalate to infra if it reoccurs.
kai: taking second shift in 20 minutes. if incident persists, handoff to me.
maya: ops-runbook step executed: increased reserved pool + disabled cross-region fallback. tracking in incident doc PD-87321 notes.
ops-bot: automated regression check queued: run evals against production prompt set for blueharbor-inc in 10min
samir: good. leaving watch. signing off at 1967803000 for short break; kai will take over.
kai: ack. i'm on standby. if p95 goes above 1.2s or enqueue >200, escalate to infra and notify eng-runtime team.
jen: will keep the change and schedule a canary rollback test to check if kvcache warming was the driver.
samir: final: incident marked "mitigated" at 1967804300. follow-up actions: 1) investigate kvcache warmup regression, 2) add alert to catch kvcache-miss-rate earlier, 3) look into routing overhead during model variant fallbacks.
maya: noted. assigning follow-up tickets to eng-runtime and infra.
jen: thanks all. closing thread after postmortem doc is linked.
incident-bot: PagerDuty PD-87321 set status=resolved at 1967804820 (closed by samir)
jen: last check p95=620ms, enqueue=40, 5xx rate back to baseline. all good to close. :white_check_mark:
